title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and the risk of non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy: a consensus statement by the North American Neuro-Ophthalmology Society and the American Academy of Ophthalmology
authors: DeParis SW, Oke I, Gaier ED, Moss HE, MacIntosh PW, Gilbert AL, et al.
funder: not stated in the abstract; PubMed lists NEI grant P30 EY026877. Financial disclosure: the authors have no proprietary or commercial interest in any materials discussed.
result: The societies state that available evidence is primarily retrospective observational studies relying on electronic health records and claims data, subject to limitations; many report a small possible increased risk of NAION with GLP-1 receptor agonists such as semaglutide, some report no correlation, and the overall magnitude of risk remains low. They recommend shared decision-making on whether to start, continue or stop GLP-1 receptor agonists.
